{{/* Tabs Component - renders tab navigation with counts Parameters: - tabs (required): Array of tab objects with fields: - id: Tab identifier (used in URL) - label: Display text - count: Optional badge count - active: Boolean - is this tab active - color: Optional badge color class (default: uses standard gray) - baseUrl (required): Base URL prefix for tab links (e.g., "?tab=") - class (optional): Additional CSS classes Usage: {{template "vendor/partials/tabs.html" (dict "tabs" (list (dict "id" "needs-attention" "label" "Needs Attention" "count" 3 "active" true "color" "bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800") (dict "id" "updating" "label" "Updating" "count" 1 "active" false "color" "bg-blue-100 text-blue-800") (dict "id" "healthy" "label" "Healthy" "count" 10 "active" false) ) "baseUrl" "?tab=" )}} Note: Since Go templates don't have a built-in list function, you'll typically construct the tabs array in your handler and pass it to the template. */}} {{/* Stratus Design System - use primary-600 for active, cool-grey for inactive */}}
{{range .tabs}} {{.label}} {{if .count}} {{.count}} {{end}} {{end}}
